Across all steps, selected Σ residency is 1,283.734680 ms and the sum of the 100 independently computed selected-set unions is 1,107.961881 ms. Ranking SHA-256 bb01c638c7464dc59de0818c41257b4386b747eb7fd8a2716d941f05e0b7de6b · tree SHA-256 ce324c640bc6c14fcbf1101bf3821bd8bf9c7a11d94f6ccf937bad1714f6b83f · observation-manifest SHA-256 27a8538e1253fefe3b7f01d3562e85b5810ffb0a00fe34c786bba741b2150332 · event-set SHA-256 383a89878f7843b4358836148ff5e5a0c25d146e28708d41bef875a73c1f0705 · ownership-set SHA-256 d3eec1d0bb7d4f1f9852131d334b122f6ddf029984967d4fea9cd187d94ba8c7.

Ranking and timing method

Each candidate is one raw leaf under one semantic operation owner. Its exact raw symbol and launch-configuration multiset are part of the identity. Every layer-turn launch owned by that leaf is first summed within one decode step. Candidates are ordered by the median of those 100 per-step residency subtotals; ties use semantic path, raw-name hash, then launch-signature hash.

For every semantic parent, the renderer gathers the exact union of all descendant raw event IDs, then computes event count, residency, and interval union directly for each step. It never sums child unions. The selected-set union follows the same direct-event rule, avoiding double-counted cross-leaf overlap.

Interpretation limits

  • Nsight Systems does not export kernel argument values or tensor pointer arguments.
  • Graph-node tracing does not by itself prove dependency edges or PDL wait/trigger semantics.
  • Overlap is context evidence, not dependency proof.
  • A baseline with fewer than 100 complete steps is preparation-only.
  • The immutable tree still carries its original template timing fields for provenance, but the report never displays them as the 10x10 row measurements.
  • Selected-set interval union is a same-GPU timeline observable, not isolated intrinsic kernel latency or a dependency-DAG critical path.
  • Selected-set incremental union contribution is the full-step union minus the non-selected event-set union; selected/non-selected pairwise overlap is reported separately. Neither is intrinsic latency.
  • Every in-scope event is owned exactly once. Any explicitly named unknown/unclassified raw leaf remains visible in the complete tree; no event is guessed, dropped, or relabeled.
